description: This file is a shell script that contains a test suite for the 'git ls-files' command, specifically testing its '--with-tree' feature in various scenarios. It sets up repositories, adds and removes files, and verifies behaviors and outputs related to this command.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that should succeed, runs the provided commands, and checks for expected results.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Runs a command expecting a specific exit code.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files or variables.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new git repository for testing.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates commits in the repository, optionally with provided messages or configurations.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.
